scope: SBLA-005 Task 6 exercise-media and presentation feasibility; this record does not select an asset or approve exercise technique.

selectedSourceMeshes.method: The 139 unique checksum-selected OBJ files in the accepted mapping were scanned for vt, vn, usemtl, and mtllib records.

sourcePresentation.description: DBCLS describes BodyParts3D as a three-dimensional whole-body model for an adult human male. The acquired representative muscle geometry is one presentation from that model. No second female, body-shape, or broader inclusive presentation variant was observed.
sourcePresentation.genderClaimUnavailableReason: The authoritative source describes biological presentation as adult human male but makes no gender-identity claim.

derivedMediaRights.rightsConclusion: The accepted current terms permit adaptation and redistribution of the optimized GLB, poster, staged stills, and an authored loop. Because selected OBJ headers retain an older share-alike notice, derived media must preserve the attribution and be handled under both notices unless later legal review resolves the historical boundary.
derivedMediaRights.requiredAttribution: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International

optimizedArtifact.inspectionMethod: The authenticated GLB JSON chunk was decoded and its nodes, meshes, materials, textures, images, TEXCOORD attributes, skins, joints, and animations counted.

materialOutcome.limitation: There are no source UV coordinates, texture images, or resolved material libraries to preserve; visual-quality scoring can assess the deterministic neutral review material only.

topology.judgmentBoundary: Boundary edges prove that all meshes are open; they do not by themselves prove visible holes. Global inward/outward orientation is unavailable for open meshes.

deterministicStill.limitation: This proves deterministic rendering of the static representative anatomy scene, not an anatomically approved exercise pose.

accessibleFallback.toolingEvidence: The deterministic poster path provides a static raster fallback; an authored SVG joint path and equivalent text can be delivered without WebGL.
accessibleFallback.contentBlock: Exercise-specific joint checkpoints and coaching text must be approved by Claude Research before a technique diagram is produced.

productionThroughput.measurementScope: Two new clean baseline-only executions of the pinned Blender 4.5.13 pipeline on the accepted 139-mesh source set; timings are observations, not a production forecast.
productionThroughput.invocation: One non-interactive Blender command with explicit mapping, source directories, external output directory, external manifest path, and --baseline-only.

mediaBudgets.measuredLoopUnavailableReason: Current artifact has no rig, joints, skin, or animation.

presentationInspection.limitation: Only one adult human male presentation was identified, so no cross-option capability parity or gender-identity claim can be made.

stagedStill.reason: The fixed-camera pipeline is deterministic, but no exercise-specific checkpoint set has been approved.

shortRiggedLoop.reason: The optimized artifact contains zero skins, joints, and animations, and no rig was observed in the inspected source inputs.

techniqueAccuracy.requiredEvidence: Exercise-specific start, midpoint, end, joint-path, range-of-motion, and common-error checkpoints with primary-source citations.

visualInspection.result: The fixed poster is sufficient to show the deterministic neutral material, incomplete muscle-only body context, and whole-scene proportions. Mesh-level checks carry topology and coordinate evidence.
knownLimitations: No head, full distal limbs, skin layer, or skeleton context is present in the representative mapped scene.
Anatomical overlap in the whole-body poster conceals some meshes; interactive selection is required.
All 139 meshes are open, so global inward/outward winding is inconclusive.
No source UV or resolved source material library survives because neither exists in the selected OBJ inputs.

reviewerJudgments.presentationConclusion: One adult human male anatomy presentation is usable for the measured static anatomy experience. Female or broader inclusive options are not demonstrated and must not be claimed.
reviewerJudgments.selectionGate: SBLA-006 owner decision remains required; this feasibility record measures and constrains the option but does not select it.
